en.headline: Modified fishing boats begin passenger trips under leisure fishery scheme
en.dek: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said two converted vessels started operating experience tours from Aberdeen on Thursday, allowing passengers to watch hauling and taste the catch.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said two fishing boats that had been modified to meet passenger safety standards began operating leisure fishery experience tours on Thursday.

The vessels, named Yut Lok 1 and Yut Lok 2, were confirmed by the Marine Department to comply with requirements for carrying passengers. Trips include watching the hauling of nets, learning about local fish species, tasting freshly caught seafood on board, and visiting the fish wholesale market.

Secretary for Environment and Ecology Tse Chin-wan officiated at the launch ceremony at the Aberdeen Fish Market. The department said the pilot forms part of efforts to develop leisure fisheries under the blueprint for sustainable agriculture and fisheries, following the earlier introduction of the scheme for fish rafts and inland farms.

The department added that the boats, previously restricted to fishing under Category III licences, can now carry passengers after resolving technical issues on equipment, licensing and insurance with the Marine Department.

zh.headline: 改裝漁船開展休閒漁業體驗團 市民可出海觀起網
zh.dek: 漁護署表示兩艘符合載客安全規格的改裝漁船周四起於香港仔營運體驗團，讓乘客近距離觀看起網並試食漁獲。
body: 漁農自然護理署表示，兩艘經改裝、符合載客安全規格的漁船於周四開始營運休閒漁業體驗團。
「漁樂1號」及「漁樂2號」已獲海事處確認符合海上航行及載客要求。行程包括觀看起網收漁獲、認識本地魚種、即場試食新鮮漁獲，以及走訪魚類批發市場。
環境及生態局局長謝展環於香港仔魚類批發市場主持開航禮。署方指，示範項目屬《漁農業可持續發展藍圖》下推動休閒漁業的措施，繼早前於魚排及內陸魚場推出計劃後延伸至漁船。
署方補充，持第III類牌照的漁船原只可捕魚，經與海事處解決設備、牌照及保險等技術問題後，現可載客營運。
